Project Name: Morningside Ministries at Menger Springs - Phase 4
Type of Funds: This project is privately funded, on private land for private use.
Scope of Work: It's an expansion to a senior living community. The work includes 4 2-story R-2 occ., type 5A apartment buildings housing 86 independent living units. This is a 1-story A-2 occ., type 5B clubhouse, and a 1-story B occ., type 5B amenity building.
Design Firm Address: 350 N Saint Paul St. #100, Dallas, Texas 75201
